digitization.what: Text files of the plotted points of NACA TR 824, one file per page of the report, made in 1994 by Gregory P. D. Siemens at the University of Saskatchewan and declared public domain in the archive's Readme.txt. Each file holds angle of attack against lift coefficient, angle of attack against moment coefficient about the quarter chord, lift coefficient against drag coefficient, and lift coefficient against moment coefficient about the aerodynamic centre.

naca0012.reason: NACA.LST of the archive lists the NACA 0006 and 0009 and no 0012, and the report could not be opened to look for it. No measured 0012 data is used in P2.

reading.how_read: Not transcribed by hand at all. The committed file is the archive's file, byte for byte (sha256 above), and the loader parses it. So there is no transcription step of this project that could be wrong, and there is no second reading of the report's figure either: the digitizer's reading error is unknown.
reading.uncertainty_method: The scatter of the digitized lift points about a straight line fitted between -6 and +6 degrees is computed in the run and reported as the reading scatter. It contains the tunnel's own scatter and any curvature, so it over-states the digitizing error alone. The highest plotted point is taken as the maximum lift; the test points are about 2 degrees apart, so a faired peak between two points could be higher by an amount the points do not show.
reading.to_close: When ntrs.nasa.gov (or another host of the scan) is allowed: open page 142 of NACA Report 824, record the figure number, and read the maximum lift, the minimum lift and five points of each lift curve twice against this file.
